title: StatefulSet: when the application has identity and a disk

videos.script: A Deployment's pods are interchangeable. Delete one and a stranger takes its place, with a new name and a new address. {{stranger}} For a web server that is exactly right. For a database it is a disaster. Each copy of a database holds its own data, and the others need to know which one they are talking to. {{db}} A StatefulSet gives each pod a name that never changes, db-0, db-1, db-2, and a disk of its own that follows the name. {{names}} You will start three, in order. You will find one of them by name through DNS. And you will delete it, and watch it come back as itself, with its data. {{itself}}
